name: labels-steps
label: Synthetic demo
alt: Eight slow steps on a made-up CT: three sheets, the published label off the face, each vertex looking along its normal, the label moved onto the recto face, abstaining over a faint stretch and a crack, the abstain mask from above, one review point per region, and the voxel label with surface and ignore values.
caption: Synthetic demo, step by step (1.2 s a step): the labels step (kit labelsnap) moving a surface onto the recto face, its abstain mask, review points and voxel label, on a made-up CT. No scan data.

scripts: couple_demo.py (kept in the source repository; it imports the AutoPipeline 0.1.10 code below)

note: Every surface, label, fiber and score here is model output on made-up data, not a reading.
